description: The power of diplomacy; the society will work with other societies to trade, learn, grow, or cooperate together or against others. Exchanging goods and ideas for prosperity, making alliances, joining dynasties by marriage, forming kingdoms and empires. Brokering peace, ending wars, negotiating borders.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical diplomacy; magical alliances, divine treaties, etc.
